articles.제목: Multiple milestones for India's nuclear projects
articles.원문 요약: Technical studies have begun onsite for Kakrapar units 5 and 6, two 700 MWe reactors planned for construction in Gujarat; India's Nuclear Fuels Complex is making steam generator tubes to support the fleet mode construction project; and India's small modular reactor project has reached a design milestone.
Slovakia's newest nuclear power unit, Mochovce 4, has been connected and started supplying its first electricity to the grid.

articles.제목: Norwegian used fuel to be stored in Sweden
articles.원문 요약: Norwegian Nuclear Decommissioning has signed an agreement with Swedish nuclear technical services provider Studsvik to manage used nuclear fuel from the former research reactors at Halden and Kjeller.

articles.제목: Thorizon, TNO launch MSR materials programme
articles.원문 요약: Molten salt reactor developer Thorizon and Dutch research and technology organisation TNO have launched a materials and corrosion programme to generate the experimental data and predictive models required to qualify materials for molten salt reactors.
